# Each minimized input in testdata/fuzz/<target>/ has a corpus line; the key of the

FuzzCompile           feature:order:emit-first:+TS2304           upstream  D266: the same upstream emit-time name reporting gives a program emitted first a TS2304 that tsc's order does not report (fuzz-hunt campaign 20261030T1258); corpus order-emit-name-error
FuzzCompile feature:declaration-consumer-TS2693:Message compiler Chapter 1 declaration content and Chapter 27 rule 4 (D366): stripInternal removes an internal schema's value but leaves its typeof type alias; corpus consumer-stripinternal

FuzzCompile feature:declaration-consumer-TS2693:N compiler Chapter 1 declaration content and Chapter 27 rule 4 (D366): stripInternal removes an internal schema's value but leaves its typeof type alias; corpus consumer-stripinternal
FuzzParse             corpus:schema-error-extends-span           compiler  Chapter 28 Linting (D61, D277): schema error E extends { … } parses to a CallExpression whose span ends before it starts ([22, 14)), and ESTree inherits the inverted range
FuzzParse             feature:parse-span-CallExpression          compiler  D61: a schema error's extends clause parses to a CallExpression with an inverted span
FuzzParse             feature:estree-range-CallExpression        compiler  Chapter 28 Linting (D277): a schema error's extends clause converts to a CallExpression whose range ends before it starts
